about: The heading of a reading from an Epistle of Saint Peter the Apostle. It names the Apostle without specifying which of his two Epistles is being read. The 1962 Roman Missal uses it over readings from both. Those of the Second and Third Sundays after Easter and of the Chair of Saint Peter, among others, come from the First, and that of the Transfiguration of Our Lord from the Second.

s01.translation: A reading from the Epistle of blessed Peter the Apostle
